scope: trusted Team task context propagation and transactional main-thread reservation
changes: Control routes parse four task fence headers as an untrusted locator.
ControlApiClient.withTeamTaskFence clones the client and emits task, owner, lease and epoch headers.
Application command and Store input shapes carry an optional TeamTaskWriteFence without changing ordinary input shape when absent.
SQLite and PostgreSQL Thread, Run, Turn and Goal writes validate the fence inside the write transaction.
Unscoped writes to a coordinating main Thread fail with team_task_main_reserved; valid fenced Team writes are accepted.
Idempotency fingerprints exclude the lease context so lease takeover does not change the semantic request.

verification.postgresCleanup: stopped and socket rejected a follow-up connection

knownUnrelatedFailures: Store full legacy fixture suite still has a legacy relative-path failure in project-foundation-legacy-snapshot; it does not enter the Team fence call path.
Store full legacy fixture suite still has a project metadata owner fixture conflict in project-text-plan-legacy-access; it does not enter the Team fence call path.
limitations: The journal remains explicitly experimental and is not enabled by the production desktop scheduler.
Routes or direct Store callers that do not carry the trusted context are only protected when the journal table is installed.
This does not complete durable Team parking/wakeup, full subtree cancellation, or autonomous sub-agent scheduling.
Synthetic model and headless integration tests do not prove installed desktop UI or real provider behavior.
